heroHeadline: Day 653: Trump Threatens Ground Troops in Mexico; Operation Free MacArthur Park Seizes 40 lbs Sinaloa Fentanyl; El Mayo Sentencing May 18
heroSubtitle: 653 days of cartel civil war — May 6: Trump signed National Counterterrorism Strategy designating Western Hemisphere cartels as highest US priority; WV court sentences Sinaloa-tied trafficker to 13+ years. May 7: Trump threatened to send US ground troops into Mexico if government fails to eliminate cartel operations — direct response to Sheinbaum's sovereignty invocation. 'Operation Free MacArthur Park' in Los Angeles: 300+ DEA/LAPD agents arrested 18, seized 40 lbs fentanyl from Sinaloa Cartel LA distribution network. NC federal court sentenced high-ranking Sinaloa member to 28 years. Bonilla Valverde governing Sinaloa; FGR's 50-official investigation proceeding. El Mayo EDNY sentencing: May 18 (11 days away). Running conflict toll: ~2,425+ since Sep 9, 2024.
